## Description

Please include a concise summary of the changes made and the problem being solved. Include any relevant background context, design decisions, or architectural implications.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (changes to markdown files or ExDocs)
- [ ] 🎨 Style/Refactor (formatting, visual cleanups, minor code adjustments with no logic changes)

## How Has This Been Tested?

- **Manual Verification**: (e.g., deployed to local k3d cluster, inspected the Bridge dashboard UI)
